43: // v2SpikeStopGate evaluates the v2 spike Stop gate conditions and returns:
44: // - continue: whether to send a continue response
45: // - request: the continue request string (only if continue is true)
46: // - note: the harvested note content (only on harvest pass)
47: // - success: whether harvest succeeded (only on harvest pass)

50: // All v2 spike logic is gated behind REPO_MEMORY_V2_SPIKE=1.
51: func v2SpikeStopGate(payload *StopPayload, convID, transcriptPath, dataDir, repoID string) (continueResp bool, request string, note string, success bool, harvestErr string) {
52: 	// Gate 0: v2 spike — hardcoded active on this branch.
53: 	// Set REPO_MEMORY_V2_SPIKE=0 to disable as a kill switch.
54: 	if os.Getenv("REPO_MEMORY_V2_SPIKE") == "0" {
55: 		return false, "", "", false, ""
56: 	}
57: 
58: 	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[repo-memory v2-spike] Stop gate evaluating: convID=%s terminationReason=%q fullyIdle=%v executionNum=%d\n",
59: 		convID, payload.TerminationReason, payload.FullyIdle, payload.ExecutionNum)
60: 
61: 	// Gate 1: Must have a conversation ID
62: 	if convID == "" {
63: 		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[repo-memory v2-spike] Gate skip: no conversation ID\n")
64: 		return false, "", "", false, ""
65: 	}
66: 
67: 	// ─── HARVEST PASS (executionNum >= 1) ───
68: 	if payload.ExecutionNum >= 1 {
69: 		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[repo-memory v2-spike] Harvest pass: executionNum=%d\n", payload.ExecutionNum)
70: 		note, success, harvestErr = v2SpikeHarvestNote(convID, transcriptPath, dataDir, repoID)
71: 		return false, "", note, success, harvestErr
72: 	}
73: 
74: 	// ─── GATE PASS (executionNum == 0) ───
75: 
76: 	// Gate 2: terminationReason must be NO_TOOL_CALL (case-insensitive)
77: 	if !strings.EqualFold(payload.TerminationReason, "NO_TOOL_CALL") {
78: 		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[repo-memory v2-spike] Gate skip: terminationReason=%q (want NO_TOOL_CALL)\n", payload.TerminationReason)
79: 		return false, "", "", false, ""
80: 	}
81: 
82: 	// Gate 3: fullyIdle must be true
83: 	if !payload.FullyIdle {
84: 		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[repo-memory v2-spike] Gate skip: fullyIdle=false\n")
85: 		return false, "", "", false, ""
86: 	}
87: 
88: 	// Gate 4: Must not be a subagent (has a parent conversation ID)
89: 	if payload.ParentConversationID != "" {
90: 		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[repo-memory v2-spike] Gate skip: subagent (parent=%s)\n", payload.ParentConversationID)
91: 		return false, "", "", false, ""
92: 	}
93: 
94: 	// All gates passed — request a continue
95: 	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[repo-memory v2-spike] Gate PASSED: requesting continue for %s\n", convID)
96: 	return true, v2SpikeNoteRequest, "", false, ""
97: }

101: func v2SpikeHarvestNote(convID, transcriptPath, dataDir, repoID string) (note string, success bool, harvestErr string) {
102: 	if transcriptPath == "" {
103: 		transcriptPath = findBrainTranscript(convID)
104: 	}

106: 		return "", false, "no transcript path available"

111: 	if err != nil {

113: 		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[repo-memory v2-spike] Harvest error: %s\n", errMsg)

115: 	}

117: 	if lastModelContent == "" {
118: 		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[repo-memory v2-spike] Harvest: no model response found in transcript\n")

120: 	}

122: 	// Check for NONE response
123: 	if strings.TrimSpace(lastModelContent) == "NONE" {
124: 		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[repo-memory v2-spike] Harvest: agent replied NONE (no notable learnings)\n")
125: 		return "NONE", true, ""
126: 	}

128: 	// Extract the repo-memory-note block
129: 	matches := noteBlockRe.FindStringSubmatch(lastModelContent)
130: 	if len(matches) < 2 {
131: 		// Check if the response contains tool calls (failure case per §5.1)
132: 		if strings.Contains(lastModelContent, "tool_calls") || strings.Contains(lastModelContent, "\"toolName\"") {

136: 		}

144: 		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[repo-memory v2-spike] Agent response was: %s\n", truncated)
145: 		return "", false, errMsg

162: // v2SpikeReadLastModelResponse reads the transcript and returns the content of the
163: // last PLANNER_RESPONSE step (the agent's response to our continue request).
164: func v2SpikeReadLastModelResponse(transcriptPath string) (string, error) {
165: 	f, err := os.Open(transcriptPath)
166: 	if err != nil {
167: 		return "", err
168: 	}
169: 	defer f.Close()
170: 
171: 	var lastModelContent string
172: 	scanner := bufio.NewScanner(f)
173: 	buf := make([]byte, 1024*1024)
174: 	scanner.Buffer(buf, 50*1024*1024) // up to 50MB per line
175: 
176: 	for scanner.Scan() {
177: 		line := scanner.Text()
178: 		if line == "" || line == "CHECKPOINT" {
179: 			continue
180: 		}
181: 
182: 		var step struct {
183: 			Source   string          `json:"source"`
184: 			Type    string          `json:"type"`
185: 			Content string          `json:"content"`
186: 			ToolCalls json.RawMessage `json:"tool_calls"`
187: 		}
188: 		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &step); err != nil {
189: 			continue
190: 		}
191: 
192: 		// Track the last model response
193: 		if step.Source == "MODEL" && step.Type == "PLANNER_RESPONSE" && step.Content != "" {
194: 			lastModelContent = step.Content
195: 		}
196: 	}
197: 
198: 	if err := scanner.Err(); err != nil {
199: 		return "", err
200: 	}
201: 
202: 	return lastModelContent, nil
203: }

207: 	noteDir := filepath.Join(dataDir, repoID, "evidence", "v2-spike-notes")

214: 	notePath := filepath.Join(noteDir, filename)

216: 	noteRecord := map[string]interface{}{
217: 		"conversation_id": convID,
218: 		"harvested_at":    time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339),
219: 		"note_content":    noteContent,
220: 		"experiment":      "X1-stop-continue",
221: 	}
222: 
223: 	data, err := json.MarshalIndent(noteRecord, "", "  ")
224: 	if err != nil {
225: 		return err
226: 	}
227: 
228: 	return os.WriteFile(notePath, data, 0644)
